物业管理 CLI 助手，用于处理物业管家日常工作。当用户提到以下场景时使用此 Skill：
- 工单/报事报修：查工单、创工单、处理投诉、巡检任务、催单、导出工单、给工单备注/评价
- 业主拜访：查拜访任务、完成任务、标记无法拜访、申请新拜访、转办任务、审批转办、拜访统计
- 业主见面会：任务派发、查任务列表、上传会议资料、导入整改表、申请转派/取消/新增任务、审批任务
- AI问答：查询项目评分、楼栋评分、人员评分、客诉评分、重要事件、业主热议、项目基本信息、项目人员列表、收缴率、满意度、评分趋势
- 配置设置：设置 accessKey、查看配置
- 到家服务：查订单、接单、派单/改派、转单给服务商、选师傅、查预约时间、洗衣履约（取件/清洗/发货）、水票/次卡查询、售后处理（审核/退款/指派再次服务）、补材料费/差价、佣金发放查询。**注意：派单或履约前须确保订单为接单状态，洗衣禁止派单。**

常见触发词：客诉评分、服务态度、诉求处理、保洁卫生、绿化养护、电梯运行、安全守护、公区维修、出行体验、噪音扰民、户内维修、水电气暖、配套设施、得分、评分、物业工单、报事报修、创建工单、查工单、拜访任务、查看到家订单、到家接单、到家派单、到家转单、到家师傅、到家材料费、到家水票、到家次卡、到家售后、到家退款、到家佣金、到家洗衣、到家取件

skills.description: Governed Ceph mgr ops: HEALTH_WARN RCA, OSD/PG/pool/RBD/CephFS/RGW, 37 tools.
skills.description_zh: Use this skill whenever the user needs to operate or diagnose a Ceph cluster via its ceph-mgr Dashboard REST API — decode a HEALTH_WARN/ERR state into cause + action (cluster_health), read the cluster status, inspect OSDs (tree/df/perf), placement groups (summary/stuck/scrub), pools (list/usable capacity), RBD images and snapshots, CephFS/MDS and RGW status, monitors/managers, slow ops and capacity forecast — plus governed writes (set cluster flags, reweight/mark-in/mark-out/purge OSDs, trigger scrubs, set pool quota/pg_num/autoscale/size, create/delete pools, create/delete RBD images and snapshots, throttle recovery/backfill). Always use this skill for "ceph health", "what does this HEALTH_WARN mean", "PG_DEGRADED / OSD_NEARFULL / SLOW_OPS / MON_DOWN", "ceph -s", "which OSD is most full", "drain an OSD", "purge an OSD", "stuck PGs", "overdue scrub", "pool usable capacity", "set pool size / quota", "rebalance is too slow / throttle backfill", "RBD image or snapshot", "MDS behind on trimming", "RGW large omap", "mon quorum", or "days to nearfull" when the context is a Ceph cluster (cephadm, hypervisor-bundled Ceph, or MicroCeph). Do NOT use when the target is not Ceph — a hypervisor, a different storage appliance, a backup product, a Kubernetes cluster, or a network device. Route those to the appropriate other AIops-tools skill (negative routing hint only). Common Ceph ops with a built-in governance harness (audit, policy, token budget, undo, risk-tiers).
skills.name: Ceph AIops
